Name: Eliasaph, Son of Deuel
Summary: Eliasaph, son of Deuel, was the prince of the tribe of Gad at the census in the wilderness; in the camp order he is also called the son of Reuel.
KeyStory: Eliasaph led Gad's 45,650 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: Two names for one man remind us that Scripture is a family record, not a list of strangers.
